name: heurion
description: Heurion monorepo root — build/test orchestration entry. Each package keeps its own pnpm install context (no workspace lockfile yet — #950: full workspace migration touches 4 CI workflows + Dockerfiles, deferred until the contracts file: snapshot problem is re-evaluated).

scripts.build:contracts: pnpm --dir packages/contracts install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir packages/contracts build
scripts.build:server: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --dir packages/server-ts install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir packages/server-ts build
scripts.build:worker: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --dir packages/worker install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir packages/worker build
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --dir packages/web install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir packages/web build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:server && pnpm run test:worker && pnpm run test:web
